subject: RM_Ogleknot
departures: body is a clumped knot of separate eyeballs, not a single round or segmented abdomen
the eyeballs are visibly mismatched, with no two the same size
no head, face, mouth or mandibles; the eye-knot is the whole body
legs are smooth, stilt-thin tendrils with no jointed, segmented arthropod leg sections, splayed out so the knot rides high
the eyes point in different directions at once, not forward together
